newsitem.title: FRANCE: FIMALAC SAYS IBCA/FITCH MERGER NEARLY DONE.
newsitem.headline: FIMALAC SAYS IBCA/FITCH MERGER NEARLY DONE.

text.p: French holding company Fimalac SA said on Monday that a merger deal between its London unit credit rating agency IBCA Ltd and Fitch Investors Service LP of New York was near completion.
"It is in the process of being signed. The texts are finalised," a spokeswoman for Fimalac said. But she could not say when a final announcement would be made.
Fitch's majority shareholder is the Van Kampen group of Grand Haven, Michigan.
Fimalac is a holding company with interests in industry, communications and market research.
IBCA executive vice president Argie Simon said on Sunday the two companies began discussing the possibility of a merger several weeks ago.
She said the merger would be one of equals in which the owners of the two companies would would retain ownership in the combined company.
